description: The splash and main windows. The main window shows the page the bundled formnet server serves on 127.0.0.1, a remote origin to Tauri, so the capability lists that address and every app command (build.rs APP_COMMANDS) has an allow permission: the page asks for the title, says when it has painted (app_ready), routes the Edit keys to a focused field on macOS and sets the view's zoom. The window permissions serve the page's own caption buttons on Windows and Linux; core:default carries the menu permissions the page uses to set the macOS menu bar.
